withdraw.title: Delete account
withdraw.description: Permanently erases your account and all data
withdraw.scope: Withdrawing immediately and permanently deletes the following, with no way back: your account and profile, every conversation session and message, raw voice recordings, compressed memories, vault notes and kanban boards/cards, favorites, and consent records. Re-signing up will not restore them (Personal Information Protection Act, Art. 21).

modeDesc.hybrid: Center stick + outer magic pad — keep the stick feel, add the pad gesture layers.
